title: Malaysia: 2025 Article IV Consultation — Annex IV
appraisal: Task-exposure model, not observed displacement; 2000 detailed job shares extrapolated to 2018. Rounded categories 27/20 are not normalized: paragraph 8 says about 48% exposed while paragraph 9 components sum to 47%; no total reconstructed.

title: GDP Income Approach 2025
appraisal: Official nominal national accounts; no AI-adoption attribution. Employee compensation is not household disposable income or a complete labor-income share.

title: Technical Notes — GDP Income Approach 2025
locator: Section 3, PDF p. 2; statistical discrepancy discussion p. 3
appraisal: GOS includes operating surplus, mixed income, depreciation and statistical discrepancy. It cannot be treated as corporate profit or all capital owners' disposable income.

title: Why AI Is Not (Yet) Behind Malaysia’s Job Losses
appraisal: Commentary inspected directly; not an independent causal study or validation of the IMF model.
